architecture_event.qualification: City hired Devereux Emmet in 1930 to design permanent course; design completion year unknown. Construction began 1931; permanent course dedicated May 28, 1932. Temporary 1930 nine not minted as an active layout.1949 actual hole changes/rerouting changed historic par 72 to 70; no current tee par inferred. Renovated course introduced July 13, 1991 and renamed New Course at Albany; this is published reintroduction date, not an exact physical-work completion day. Later official rename to Capital Hills has no exact year. Historical farmland area/acquisition is not current acreage/ownership certification.
